cleanup_eval_depth: create a depth cleanup mask by comparing point cloud depth against image depth using a sigma threshold
run_cleanup_eval_depth: run cleanup_eval_depth on a point cloud and depth tensor to filter inconsistent depth values
test_cleanup_eval_depth: test cleanup_eval_depth with a Pointclouds object, camera, depth tensor, and mask tensor
